offer.text: My windowsill is so drab. Could you pick me 8 wildflowers? Any colors will do.

accept.text: Oh, how lovely of you! The meadows are full this time of year.

decline.text: Ah well. Grey days suit me, I suppose.

ready.text: Eight blooms! My window will be the cheeriest on the lane.

complete.text: You've brightened more than the sill, friend.
